nodes.name: Chloride Corrosion Synthesis of Ni5Co3Mo-OH
nodes.procedure: Synthesizing multimetallic hydroxide nanosheet arrays supported on NF by fully utilizing a high concentration of chloride ions (Cl-) to corrode NF in a one-step route. The NF was corroded to Ni2+ ions in a high concentration of Cl- solution occurring in the anode region. Then, the chloride ions continuously migrated and enriched the anode region. Simultaneously, the oxygen from the air or water reacted with water to form hydroxide (OH-) on the cathode. Finally, the Mx+ cations (Co and Mo) and the diffusion of Ni2+ synchronously reacted with OH- to precipitate and form multimetallic hydroxide nanosheet arrays supported on NF.
